commands:
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -m state --state NEW<sp>-p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-o-a-iptables-new
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-o-a-iptables-new
<iptables> -X f2b-o-a-iptables-new

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -m state --state NEW<sp>-p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-o-a-iptables-new
done; done
